columns.justification: Assigned when the build is created. Identifier — not a model feature.
columns.meaning: Travis CI build id of the analysed build.
columns.name: tr_build_id

columns.justification: Known before the build. Identifier — not a model feature.
columns.meaning: GitHub repository name (owner/repo).
columns.name: gh_project_name

columns.justification: Property of the trigger event.
columns.meaning: Whether a pull request triggered the build.
columns.name: gh_is_pr

columns.justification: A PR build needs an open PR, so the PR predates it. Measured exceptions (PR created after the build started; data errors) are counted under Invariant checks — features derived from it (e.g. PR age) must tolerate negative values.
columns.meaning: For PR builds: when the pull request was opened (UTC).
columns.name: gh_pr_created_at

columns.justification: Known at trigger time. Identifier — not a model feature.
columns.meaning: For PR builds: the pull request number on GitHub.
columns.name: gh_pull_req_num

columns.justification: Repository metadata, used to select the Java subset. Context — not a model feature.
columns.meaning: Dominant repository language according to GitHub (partition key).
columns.name: gh_lang

columns.justification: Describes how the PR was closed, which can happen after the build — possible future information.
columns.meaning: For commits on a PR: how that PR was eventually closed (merge button, manual merge, ...).
columns.name: git_merged_with

columns.justification: Known at trigger time. Context — not a model feature.
columns.meaning: Branch that was built.
columns.name: git_branch

columns.justification: The triggering push precedes the build.
columns.meaning: Number of commits in the push that triggered the build (from GHTorrent push events; nil when no push event was recorded).
columns.name: gh_num_commits_in_push

columns.justification: The triggering push precedes the build. Identifier — not a model feature.
columns.meaning: The commits contained in the triggering push.
columns.name: gh_commits_in_push

columns.justification: Derived from git history up to the built commit.
columns.meaning: Why the backwards walk for the previously built commit stopped: no previous build, previous build found, or a merge point reached.
columns.name: git_prev_commit_resolution_status

columns.justification: Refers to an earlier commit. Identifier — not a model feature.
columns.meaning: Commit of the previous build on the linearised history (nil at a merge point).
columns.name: git_prev_built_commit

columns.justification: The id is known at trigger time, but that build's outcome may not be (use the finished-before rule). Identifier — not a model feature.
columns.meaning: Build triggered by git_prev_built_commit (nil at a merge point).
columns.name: tr_prev_build

columns.justification: The triggering push precedes the build.
columns.meaning: Timestamp of the first commit in the triggering push (UTC; nil when no push event was recorded).
columns.name: gh_first_commit_created_at

columns.justification: The docs bound it to the window ending when the build was triggered.
columns.meaning: Developers who committed directly or merged PRs in the 3 months up to the build trigger.
columns.name: gh_team_size

columns.justification: List of commit SHAs that exist before the build. Identifier — not a model feature.
columns.meaning: All commits built by this build, walking back to (excluding) the previous built commit or up to a merge point; the basis of the git_diff_* / gh_diff_* columns.
columns.name: git_all_built_commits

columns.justification: Computed from the commits being built, which exist before the build starts.
columns.meaning: Number of commits in git_all_built_commits.
columns.name: git_num_all_built_commits

columns.justification: Known at trigger time. Identifier — not a model feature.
columns.meaning: Commit that triggered the build.
columns.name: git_trigger_commit

columns.justification: Known at trigger time. Identifier — not a model feature.
columns.meaning: For PR builds: the target-branch commit the PR commit was merged into for testing.
columns.name: tr_virtual_merged_into

columns.justification: Not time-bounded to the build start in the docs; may count comments written after the build — possible future information.
columns.meaning: For commits linked to a PR: number of discussion comments on that PR.
columns.name: gh_num_issue_comments

columns.justification: Not time-bounded to the build start in the docs; may count comments written after the build — possible future information.
columns.meaning: Number of GitHub comments on the built commits.
columns.name: gh_num_commit_comments

columns.justification: Not time-bounded to the build start in the docs; may count review comments written after the build — possible future information.
columns.meaning: For PR builds: number of code-review comments on the pull request.
columns.name: gh_num_pr_comments

columns.justification: Computed from the commits being built, which exist before the build starts.
columns.meaning: Lines of production code changed across the built commits.
columns.name: git_diff_src_churn

columns.justification: Computed from the commits being built, which exist before the build starts.
columns.meaning: Lines of test code changed across the built commits.
columns.name: git_diff_test_churn

columns.justification: Computed from the commits being built, which exist before the build starts.
columns.meaning: Files added by the built commits.
columns.name: gh_diff_files_added

columns.justification: Computed from the commits being built, which exist before the build starts.
columns.meaning: Files deleted by the built commits.
columns.name: gh_diff_files_deleted

columns.justification: Computed from the commits being built, which exist before the build starts.
columns.meaning: Files modified by the built commits.
columns.name: gh_diff_files_modified

columns.justification: Computed from the commits being built, which exist before the build starts.
columns.meaning: Test cases added by the built commits.
columns.name: gh_diff_tests_added

columns.justification: Computed from the commits being built, which exist before the build starts.
columns.meaning: Test cases deleted by the built commits.
columns.name: gh_diff_tests_deleted

columns.justification: Computed from the commits being built, which exist before the build starts.
columns.meaning: Production source files changed by the built commits.
columns.name: gh_diff_src_files

columns.justification: Computed from the commits being built, which exist before the build starts.
columns.meaning: Documentation files changed by the built commits.
columns.name: gh_diff_doc_files

columns.justification: Computed from the commits being built, which exist before the build starts.
columns.meaning: Changed files that are neither source code nor documentation.
columns.name: gh_diff_other_files

columns.justification: The docs bound it to the window ending when the build was triggered.
columns.meaning: Distinct commits in the 3 months up to the trigger that touched the files changed by the built commits (how active that code area is).
columns.name: gh_num_commits_on_files_touched

columns.justification: Repository state at the built commit.
columns.meaning: Executable production source lines in the whole repository (comments excluded).
columns.name: gh_sloc

columns.justification: Repository state at the built commit.
columns.meaning: Test density: lines of test code per 1,000 gh_sloc.
columns.name: gh_test_lines_per_kloc

columns.justification: Repository state at the built commit.
columns.meaning: Test density: test cases per 1,000 gh_sloc.

columns.justification: Repository state at the built commit.
columns.meaning: Assert density: assertions per 1,000 gh_sloc.
columns.name: gh_asserts_cases_per_kloc

columns.justification: The docs bound it to the 3 months before the commit.
columns.meaning: Whether the commit author committed or merged at least once in the 3 months before the commit (core team member).
columns.name: gh_by_core_team_member

columns.justification: The PR exists before its builds. Caveat: the docs do not say the text was captured at build time, so later edits cannot be ruled out.
columns.meaning: For PR builds: total words in the PR title and description.
columns.name: gh_description_complexity

columns.justification: The push precedes the build.
columns.meaning: Timestamp of the triggering push as reported by GitHub (UTC).
columns.name: gh_pushed_at

columns.justification: Trigger time; used for ordering, history windows and time features. UTC confirmed in M2 review: equal to the secondary archive's explicit-UTC started_at for all 27,055 builds joined on tr_build_id. Caveat: a restart overwrites it (DATASET_AUDIT §4.3).
columns.meaning: Build trigger/start timestamp as reported by Travis (UTC); the docs describe it as the Travis-provided time of the triggering push.
columns.name: gh_build_started_at

columns.justification: Measured to advance ~1 day per day of gh_build_started_at within a project (see evidence), i.e. repository age at build time.
columns.meaning: Not described on the official data-format page.
columns.name: gh_repo_age

columns.justification: Measured to vary over time within a project (see evidence), consistent with a commit count at build time rather than a crawl-time snapshot.
columns.meaning: Not described on the official data-format page.
columns.name: gh_repo_num_commits

columns.meaning: Full build duration reported by the Travis API. Summed job time, not wall-clock (DATASET_AUDIT §4.1; equal to that archive's duration for 26,990 of 27,055 builds joined in M2 review), so started_at + tr_duration only bounds the finish time.

gh_repo_age.method: per-project OLS slope of gh_repo_age on days since epoch of gh_build_started_at (Java projects with >= 20 builds)

master_push_builds.method: same, restricted to non-PR builds on git_branch = 'master'

gh_repo_num_commits.method: share of consecutive builds of a project (ordered by gh_build_started_at) whose value does not decrease

pr_created_after_build_start.rule: gh_pr_created_at <= gh_build_started_at (a PR build needs an open PR)

prev_build_not_earlier.rule: tr_prev_build < tr_build_id (the previous build was created earlier)

measurement.build_grain: one row per tr_build_id (the job row with the lowest tr_job_id)
measurement.null_definition: SQL NULL after conversion (raw empty field or the 'NA' token)
